$comment: Gzip budgets for the chunks a first visit downloads (#258 §7), in kB (1000 B, the unit `vite build` prints). `module` is the source module that identifies the chunk in dist/.vite/manifest.json. Measured 2026-11-22 on main + #258: entry 139.8, webgpu 124.3, webgl2 18.8 — each budget is that plus about 8 %. Raising one is a decision: say in the PR what the bytes buy. Checked by `npm run check:bundle-budget` (scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs).
